UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Player profile storing selected AeroDash skin, trail, unlocked skins, and aggregate stats.

unlockedSkins.description: Bounded list of unlocked skin IDs (max 20).

totalOrbs.description: Total Aero Orbs earned for unlocking skins.

totalAttempts.description: Total gameplay attempts across all levels.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

LevelProgress.title: LevelProgress
LevelProgress.description: Per-level completion progress, best percentage, coins, and attempts for a user.

completed.description: Whether the level has been cleared to 100%.

attempts.description: Number of attempts on this level.

coinsCollected.description: Maximum Aero Coins collected in a single or best run (0..3).

bestTimeMs.description: Fastest completion time in milliseconds (0 if not yet cleared).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of first recorded attempt (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last progress update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Player profile and unlocked Frutiger Aero customization items.

/users/{userId}/levelProgress/{levelId}.description: Per-level high scores, completion flags, and coin counts for a player.
